01Target: +25% GMV and a protected bottom line

AED 20.6M in November: +25% on Nov '25 and +16% on Nov '24. It's a stretch: November must reach 3.2x September's daily GMV (LY 1.9x, LLY 2.2x). The trend is improving, from −28% YoY in September to −7% for 1–12 October.

The Nov '26 target of AED 20.6M is 16% above the Nov '24 peak

Beauty GMV by month, AED. 2026 is running 28% below 2025 to September.

03Stock: enough to hit the target, and the 10-week cap is within reach

We close under the 193K cap if retail holds October's trend or hits the November target

Year-end retail units. 2026 = 503K available, minus retail sales from 13 Oct to 31 Dec. Red: over the cap.

psku_sku_mapped and stock_summary_history, 12 Oct · POs ETA before 31 Dec at 80% fill · WoC vs Dec '25 retail units (19.3K a week)
  • 503K retail units available (262K on hand + 241K from POs at 80% fill) = AED 53.2M at retail, 2.9x November's retail need. 91% of PO units land before 1 Nov.
  • Plan case closes at 46K units (2.4 WoC). November retail of AED 18.5M is about 347K units at LY's promo ASP. Range: 8K to 81K units, depending on whether November ASP is 10% below or 11% above LY.
  • Charlotte Tilbury capped at 30% markdown: +2.7K units at year end (2.5 WoC). CT sold 13.6K units in Nov '25 at 55% markdown, 2.9x October. In Nov '24, at 6%, it sold 1.3x October. At 30% we expect 2.1x the October run-rate: 8.9K units at ASP AED 154 (LY 98), AED 1.37M. Other brands need to fill the AED 0.25M gap. CT itself closes the year at 11K units, 8 weeks of its own cover, up from 3.5K.
  • The risk is running out of stock, not overstock. NYX and Make Up For Ever cover their November need only 1.1x.

Method: retail GMV only. Sales from 13 Oct to 31 Dec = LY retail GMV × TY trend ÷ TY retail ASP. CT scenario: November unit lift over October interpolated between Nov '24 (6% MKD, 1.3x) and Nov '25 (55%, 2.9x). PO SKUs with no live price are valued at cost × 1.35.

06What Nov '24 and Nov '25 taught us

1

UCR rises on heavy-traffic days

Traffic and conversion grow together: correlation 0.78–0.79 in both years.

Busiest days convert at about 3.7% vs 2.3–2.5% on the quietest

November days split into thirds by Beauty impressions. UCR = units / product views.

Nov 2024Nov 2025
onsite_measures, sales_metrics · 1–30 Nov
2

Traffic isn't going where it converts best

GMV per 1K impressions: Kérastase AED 134, Charlotte Tilbury AED 63, La Roche-Posay AED 62, vs a Beauty average of AED 40.

3

Sets and launches are November's margin heroes

In 2025, set GMV fell 34% and launch GMV fell 42%. A strong line-up is the cheapest way to protect PC1.

Sets and launches carry November margin; they grew fastest in 2024, not 2025

Bars: November daily GMV as a multiple of Sep–Oct. Below: November PC1 before rebates.

Nov 2024Nov 2025
sales_metrics, item_d · sets = gift_sets, launches = live < 120 days
4

Deeper markdown did not buy growth

Markdown went from 35% to 44%, GMV fell 8%, and PC1 before rebates went from +5.6% to −5.2%. Rebates (AED 2.36M) lifted LY to +10.3%, but half went to NYX and Maybelline; Charlotte Tilbury and Kylie had none. No event markdown without agreed brand funding.
